tax: Taxa pentru folosirea drumurilor de către autovehiculele înmatriculate în Republica Moldova
statute: Codul fiscal Titlul IX art. 337-340, anexa nr. 1 pct. 1 (motorcycles), pct. 2 (cars per cm³), pct. 5 (tractors), pct. 6 (lorries by total mass), pct. 7 (buses by seats)
dated: Codul fiscal nr. 1163/1997 as in force 01.01.2025, read on legis.md in a browser on 25-26 November 2026 (doc_id=138612)
unsupported: trailers and semi-trailers (anexa nr. 1 pct. 3, 4, per tonne of load capacity) are not modelled: the input has no load capacity
a car with no engine capacity (electric) has no row in pct. 2: no charge, listed as grade C
the exemption of persons with locomotor disabilities (art. 343) is not in the input
reading taken: the rate of the car's band applies to its whole engine capacity
the kind names lorry, bus and tractor are the model's own

statute: Codul fiscal art. 6 alin. (5), (6) (the Code's list of state and local taxes)
dated: Codul fiscal nr. 1163/1997 as in force 01.01.2025, read on legis.md in a browser on 25-26 November 2026 (doc_id=138612)
tried: art. 6 (5), (6) read: the other taxes are impozitul privat, the local fees of Titlul VII, the natural-resource charges of Titlul VIII, the vignette (Titlul IX capitolul 3) none of these is modelled. The single tax of IT-park residents (Titlul X) is modelled under 1200
